scripts.build: tsc -b && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.json --pretty false && node apps/demo/build-client.mjs
scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run lint && tsx --test tests/**/*.test.ts tests/**/*.test.mjs
